## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup (no functional change)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Build / CI change

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and followed its conventions.
- [ ] The code compiles cleanly with `./gradlew build`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where relevant.
- [ ] I added or updated documentation (`README.md` / `BUILD.md`) where relevant.
- [ ] I did **not** commit `gradle-wrapper.jar`, `build/`, or `.gradle/` artifacts.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, etc.).
- [ ] The branch is up to date with `main`.
